insight: Formerly Replexica; rebranded to Lingo.dev in Dec 2024 after a $4.2M YC seed led by Initialized Capital.
name: Lingo.dev
tagline: Open-source AI localization for web and mobile apps, built for developers and CI/CD.
description: Lingo.dev is a localization engineering platform that translates app content through configurable localization engines persisting glossaries, brand voice, and per-locale model chains. Developers call it from an open-source CLI, a React compiler, a GitHub Action, or the API, so translations regenerate automatically on every commit instead of being pasted into a separate web tool. Customers include Mistral AI, Cal.com, and Solana.

modelSupport.notes: Configurable per-locale model chains; LLM costs passed through at zero markup plus an infrastructure fee.

edge: Runs as an open-source CLI and compiler inside your repo and CI, auto-translating on each commit — not a separate web TMS you paste strings into.
pros: LLM cost passed through at zero markup
cons: Hosted engine is proprietary, only the tooling is open

references.title: Software Localization Startup Lingo.dev Raises USD 4.2M Seed Round
